### CVE-2015-2281
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2015-03-19 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 36422: Fortinet Single Sign On - Stack Overflow (dos/windows, 2015-03-18, verified=1)

Stack-based buffer overflow in collectoragent.exe in Fortinet Single Sign On (FSSO) before build 164 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a large PROCESS_HELLO message to the Message Dispatcher on TCP port 8000.

### CVE-2015-4077
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2015-09-03 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 45149: Fortinet FortiClient 5.2.3 (Windows 10 x64 Creators) - Local Privilege Escalation (local/windows_x86-64, 2018-08-05, verified=1)

The (1) mdare64_48.sys, (2) mdare32_48.sys, (3) mdare32_52.sys, and (4) mdare64_52.sys drivers in Fortinet FortiClient before 5.2.4 allow local users to read arbitrary kernel memory via a 0x22608C ioctl call.

### CVE-2015-5736
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2015-09-03 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 45149: Fortinet FortiClient 5.2.3 (Windows 10 x64 Creators) - Local Privilege Escalation (local/windows_x86-64, 2018-08-05, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 41722: Fortinet FortiClient 5.2.3 (Windows 10 x64 Post-Anniversary) - Local Privilege Escalation (local/windows_x86-64, 2017-03-25, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 41721: Fortinet FortiClient 5.2.3 (Windows 10 x64 Pre-Anniversary) - Local Privilege Escalation (local/windows_x86-64, 2017-03-25, verified=1)

The Fortishield.sys driver in Fortinet FortiClient before 5.2.4 allows local users to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges by setting the callback function in a (1) 0x220024 or (2) 0x220028 ioctl call.
